note: D9 starting spec for pour tea, written in tokens to mirror manip_sim/pour_stages.py: the carry holds teapot.up_axis to world.z (tight) with translation free (the path holds from the lifted entry, so no band there); the carry goal puts the spout tip centered (moderate) over the opening at clearance large / slack snug, the same band as the pour path, so the hand-off lies inside the pour's path; the pour tips teapot.front_axis to mug.-up (tight), a sweep about the teapot's lateral axis, with the spout tip held over the opening

emissions.name: grasp the teapot by its handle
emissions.verify: The gripper is closed on the handle with the grasp point at teapot.handle_center; the teapot is still upright at its spawn pose.
emissions.goal: The gripper closes on the teapot's handle at teapot.handle_center, with the teapot still upright at its spawn pose.

emissions.name: transport teapot above mug
emissions.verify: Throughout the carry teapot.+up stays within a small angle of world.z so the pot never tips; at the subgoal teapot.handle_center lies within a few cm of mug.opening_center in x/y and in a band starting about 8 cm above it, keeping the pot body clear of the mug rim, with heading about the vertical left free.
emissions.goal: Carry the teapot upright until teapot.handle_center sits roughly over mug.opening_center and well above the mug rim, with teapot.+up still pointing the way world.z points.

emissions.name: pour
emissions.verify: The teapot rotates about its level lateral axis (teapot.+left stays horizontal throughout) until teapot.+front points downward along mug.-up, with teapot.handle_center remaining in the band above mug.opening_center and laterally over the mug.
emissions.goal: The teapot tips forward about its level lateral axis until teapot.+front (the spout direction) points the way mug.-up points, while the teapot stays above mug.opening_center so the stream falls into the mug.
